answer: Composition itself creates split ownership, dual-path permission, cross-plane ordering, and duplicated state. Detector (detector.py) scans capability_to_authority; planted duplicate on authorization fires (findings=1); clean singular mapping is silent (findings=0); empty table fails extraction-control; naive A1+A2 union findings=2. A9/DESIGN.json present=False. Reviewer added FM-AUTHORITY-STRING-COLLISION. SUCCESS:ARC-0061

ordering_constraints.failure_if_violated: TOCTOU: a process is activated and then denied; the resident set has already mutated and the deny cannot un-start the process.
The cc command mutates owner-visible state without a permission verdict; A8 becomes a second, quieter permission path.
Catalog lists capabilities that are not in SSOT, or hides ones that are; the owner navigates a second catalog authority.
ordering_constraints.required_order: generate catalog records before the catalog surface lists them
ordering_constraints.source: A2 DESIGN generate(registry) + A8 catalog surface

ordering_constraints.failure_if_violated: Activate an unpinned, stale, or revoked package.
Vendor call with no crash-recoverable intent record; work vanishes on adapter death.
A failure path omits happened / means / next_action because the contract was not loaded first.
An on-disk capability absent from MANIFEST.json is silently not loaded (A1 unlisted_file).
ordering_constraints.required_order: MANIFEST.json listed before capability files load

ordering_constraints.failure_if_violated: Consumers read missing or stale generated files (ARC-0012 Direction A).
ordering_constraints.required_order: generate() before any consumer reads generated bytes

ordering_constraints.failure_if_violated: A vendor-only capability is treated as guaranteed.
Work is dispatched to a capability that is installed but not activated.
ordering_constraints.required_order: gateway resident-set floor applied before distributed work dispatch

question: Enumerate the failure modes created by COMPOSITION itself: two subsystems each owning part of one decision, a capability reachable by two paths with different permission checks, an ordering dependency between control planes, and duplicated state. Then specify a MECHANICAL detector for duplicate control planes that can run in CI over the design artifacts.

added_failure_mode.description: The detector keys duplicate detection on exact authority strings. If A2 generated catalogs and the A8 catalog surface are both labelled 'catalog', the row looks singular while two planes still govern the capability. Exact-string equality is not identity of planes.
added_failure_mode.required_followup: Give every plane a stable plane_id independent of display name, and treat alias maps as a second detector input, not a comment.
added_failure_mode.title: Distinct planes collapsed by identical authority strings

reviewer.enumeration_certify_reason: The 47 seeded classes are cited as _USER-PROMPTS.md:11300-11347. That file is not on this worktree. Certifying completeness against an unread list would be overclaim. Instead the reviewer adds FM-AUTHORITY-STRING-COLLISION, which the author's exact-string detector missed.
reviewer.method: Reviewed the author's four composition classes (split decision, dual-path permission, ordering, duplicated state) and the exact-string detector. Scope is: both-states, extraction-control, ordering list with failure-if-violated, one missed mode. Agreement with the hybrid being a good idea is not required.

scenario.catching_architecture: Mechanical duplicate-control-plane detector over capability_to_authority tables (ARC-0061 detector.py). Fail-closed on any capability with two authorities. A zero is trusted only after extraction-control finds capability-declaration.
procedure: Write a singular composed capability_to_authority table from catalog-derived A1–A8 planes (source DESIGN.json files are absent on this worktree).
Run detector.py on the clean table; require extraction-control and zero duplicate findings.
Plant a second authority (A8-product-surface) on authorization; require the detector to fire on that capability.
Run the detector on an empty table and refuse to treat that zero as CLEAN (extraction-control).
Run the detector on the naive A1+A2 union and record duplicate findings on capability-declaration.
Enumerate every cross-plane ordering constraint with the failure it causes if reversed.
scenario.title: Planted duplicate authority fires; clean composed mapping is silent

strongest_surviving_counterargument: Operators will keep a second plane as a hot overlay (A8 catalog view beside A2 generated catalogs, A1 static tree beside generated bytes) because the two views 'always agree' in the common case. That preference survives as an operational habit. It does not make dual authority fail-closed, it does not make a vacuous zero a pass, and it does not conjure A9/DESIGN.json on this worktree.
title: A9 (maximal hybrid): Failure modes created by composition itself, and a mechanical duplicate-control-plane detector
